subject: planner: support left outer anti semi join for hash join v2 (#58648)
summary: Diff only expands `canUseHashJoinV2()` to include `logicalop.AntiLeftOuterSemiJoin` in `pkg/planner/core/exhaust_physical_plans.go`. This makes executor selection eligible to use HashJoin V2 for left outer anti semi join when other existing constraints pass (non-cross, non-NullEQ, non-null-aware). HashJoin V2’s probe factory explicitly supports `AntiLeftOuterSemiJoin` only when right side is build; planner’s hash-join enumeration for this join type constructs only the right-build variant, so no new panic/correctness risk was found. Upstream `master` retains this support (moved to `pkg/planner/core/operator/physicalop/physical_hash_join.go`).
